title: Pressure injury stages

findings.where: Images 1, 7, 9 and 15; step "other"; DeepTissueStrip lower injury oval
findings.title: DTPI illustration depicts damage inside bone
findings.problem: The lower filled injury oval covers roughly 70% of the bone band's height. With coral explicitly representing damaged tissue, this depicts bony injury rather than soft-tissue injury at the bone–muscle interface. It adds an anatomical finding that the definition and narration do not establish.
findings.fix: Constrain the deep lesion to the muscle/soft-tissue side, abutting the upper bone boundary and extending toward the skin. Keep the bone band visually intact and label the bone–muscle interface.

assessment: Revise the deep-tissue illustration before publication. Its damage overlay extends substantially into the bone band.
